PeDescription_pe_reverse_descriptive: One coherent natural-language paragraph that faithfully restores the image by five points (composition, subject, environment, text, style); for natural-language prompt models such as Flux and MJ.
PeName_pe_reverse_sd: SD tags · Stable Diffusion prompt format
PeDescription_pe_reverse_sd: One line of comma-separated SD positive tags with the full restoration checklist; for tag-based models such as SD1.5, SDXL and ComfyUI.
PeDescription_pe_reverse_danbooru: One line of English Danbooru-style tags (space-separated phrases like long hair) with strict artist:/copyright:/character: prefix order; for anime LoRA and SD training.
PeDescription_pe_torii_long_thoughts_v2: 4-section Markdown: 1 character thoughts, 2 key details, 3 long description, 4 per-character details (## character name). Best paired with the character name list; no dedicated parts / on-image text / background sections.
PeDescription_pe_torii_long_thoughts: 6-section Markdown: 1 thoughts, 2 general description, 3 per-character, 4 individual parts, 5 texts on image, 6 background and effects. Adds parts/text/background sections over v2; good for complex images and datasets.
PeDescription_pe_torii_min_structured_md: Short structured Markdown; includes the first two reasoning sections. For finished prompts use the body-only variant or remove §1–2 yourself.
Same as min_structured_md, automatically dropping §1 Thoughts and §2 Key details, keeping §3 Structured description.
PeDescription_pe_torii_min_structured_js: JSON keyed by character/General etc.; output is standard JSON text (not key: flattened).
PeDescription_pe_torii_json: Fields such as character/background/atmosphere; output is standard JSON text.
PeDescription_pe_torii_long: 2–5 paragraphs of natural-language long description, no Markdown structure, supports character names.
PeDescription_pe_torii_short: Brief and to the point, covering main subjects and details without verbose rhetoric.
PeDescription_pe_torii_md_comic: Markdown for comics/storyboards: format notes, per-panel descriptions and a summary, including reasoning sections.
PeDescription_pe_torii_json_comic: Per-frame and per-character JSON comic description; output is standard JSON text.
